responsibility: Provides the machine-description patterns for bitwise logical operations and single-bit manipulation on the R8C/M16C/M32C backend. It covers target-specific encodings for and/ior/xor/not as well as bset/bclr-based optimizations, distinguishes the very different A16 and A24 bit-addressing models, supplies expanders that choose the proper family-specific insns, and includes insert-bit support used for volatile bitfields and other bit-addressable memory operations.
